title: 3.6.0: Exercises
originalText:
For the following exercises, identify each number as a natural number, an integer, a rational number, or a real number.

Exercise \(\PageIndex{1}\)

\(\frac{1}{3}\)

Exercise \(\PageIndex{2}\)

16

Exercise \(\PageIndex{3}\)

\(\sqrt{19}\)

Exercise \(\PageIndex{4}\)

\(-\frac{3}{7}\)

Exercise \(\PageIndex{5}\)

\(\pi\)

Exercise \(\PageIndex{6}\)

-47

Exercise \(\PageIndex{7}\)

13

Exercise \(\PageIndex{8}\)

\(\frac{31}{7}\)

For the following exercises, correctly place the numbers in the Venn diagram.

[Figure: A Venn diagram shows four concentric ovals. The ovals are labeled from inner to outer as follows: N, Z, Q, and R.]

For the following exercises, identify the property of real numbers that is being illustrated.

Exercise \(\PageIndex{11}\)

\(14+38.9=38.9+14\)

Exercise \(\PageIndex{12}\)

\(37.12+98=98+37.12\)

Exercise \(\PageIndex{13}\)

\(38 \times 16=16 \times 38\)

Exercise \(\PageIndex{14}\)

\(6.3 \times \sqrt{14}=\sqrt{14} \times 6.3\)

Exercise \(\PageIndex{15}\)

\(4+(8+\sqrt{7})=(4+8)+\sqrt{7}\)

Exercise \(\PageIndex{16}\)

\(13 \times\left(\frac{6}{11} \times 14\right)=\left(13 \times \frac{6}{11}\right) \times 14\)

Exercise \(\PageIndex{17}\)

\((5.6 \times 8.7) \times 6=5.6 \times(8.7 \times 6)\)

Exercise \(\PageIndex{18}\)

\((3.8+\sqrt{5})+13=3.8+(\sqrt{5+13})\)

Exercise \(\PageIndex{19}\)

\(4 \times(5+\sqrt{3})=4 \times 5+4 \times \sqrt{3}\)

Exercise \(\PageIndex{20}\)

\(\sqrt{74}+(-\sqrt{74})=0\)

Exercise \(\PageIndex{22}\)

\(17 \times\left(\frac{1}{17}\right)=1\)

Exercise \(\PageIndex{23}\)

\(4 \sqrt{35}+0=4 \sqrt{35}\)

Exercise \(\PageIndex{24}\)

\(\sqrt{17} \times(5+3.6)=\sqrt{17} \times 5+\sqrt{17} \times 3.6\)

Exercise \(\PageIndex{26}\)

\(\frac{3}{\sqrt{7}} \times 1=\frac{3}{\sqrt{7}}\)

Exercise \(\PageIndex{27}\)

\(3 \pi+7 \sqrt{21}=7 \sqrt{21}+3 \pi\)

Exercise \(\PageIndex{28}\)

\(14 \times(3 \sqrt{2}+11.6)=14 \times 3 \sqrt{2}+14 \times 11.6\)

For the following exercises, use properties of real numbers and mental math to calculate the expression.

Exercise \(\PageIndex{29}\)

\(43+62+17\)

Exercise \(\PageIndex{30}\)

\(106+75+94\)

Exercise \(\PageIndex{31}\)

\(5 \times 13 \times 4\)

Exercise \(\PageIndex{32}\)

\(4 \times 72 \times 5\)

Exercise \(\PageIndex{33}\)

\(46+77+23+24+103\)

Exercise \(\PageIndex{34}\)

\(23+98+75+12+77\)

Exercise \(\PageIndex{35}\)

\(4 \times 13 \times 25\)

Exercise \(\PageIndex{36}\)

\(50 \times 23 \times 2\)

Exercise \(\PageIndex{37}\)

\(13 \times 99\)

Exercise \(\PageIndex{38}\)

\(15 \times 39\)

Exercise \(\PageIndex{39}\)

\(43 \times 101\)

Exercise \(\PageIndex{40}\)

\(16 \times 999\)
